title: Clicks' Power Keyboard brings BlackBerry-style typing to any phone — with some compromises | TechCrunch
summary: However, in its current implementation, the Power Keyboard suffers from the same fate as the company’s earlier Clicks keyboard — a smartphone case that included a physical keyboard. We quickly paired the device with our Android phone.
